person_note: The book alternates narrative person: Win narrates sustained sections in first person, while the Myron-centered sections use third-person narration. Quotes q01189 and q01195 expose Win's participating voice, and q01183 exposes the external Myron narration; the authorized Penguin sample independently displays the same switch. First-person speech, generic 'you,' aphorisms, and acknowledgments were excluded as non-base material. Multiple whole-book reviews explicitly confirm the recurring two-person structure, leaving no material uncertainty. Source audit: SuperSummary is Tier C; the authorized sample and independent quote signals still directly establish both persons.
